depictions.name: Takigai-san
depictions.text: Takigai-san was a rundown tower situated in the Shattered Coast in Wakasa, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke arrived at the bandit-infested tower, climbed atop it, and surveyed the land.
